name: W Hollywood
positioning: A design-led hotel on Hollywood & Vine, steps from the Pantages Theatre, with a rooftop WET Deck facing the Hollywood Hills and suites with Hollywood Sign views
best_for: Travelers who want to be in the middle of Hollywood's theatres and nightlife
Guests who want a suite with views of the Hollywood Sign and the city

facts.text: W Hollywood is in the heart of Hollywood, at the edge of the Hills.
The hotel is on Hollywood & Vine.
The hotel is steps from the Pantages Theatre.
The hotel is just down the road from the TCL Chinese Theatre, the Dolby Theatre and the Egyptian Theatre.
Rooms have Venetian plaster-inspired walls, curved furniture and oversized window seats.
The triple-height Living Room has green velvet seating and a mirrored ceiling installation.
Suites have Davines bath products and Comfort Zone soaps and lotions.
Premium pool seating includes cabanas and daybeds.
CEO2 Health at the hotel offers hyperbaric oxygen, an infrared sauna and a cold plunge.
The FIT gym has Technogym machines and Peloton bikes.
The hotel offers on-property electric car rentals by the hour or by the day.
The Living Room bar has live music on Fridays and Saturdays.

highlights.text: The rooftop WET Deck has panoramic views of the Hollywood Hills.
The corner Supreme Suite has panoramic views of the Hollywood Sign, the Capitol Records building and Griffith Observatory.
The Oasis Suite has a private billiards room and a full wet bar.
The Penthouse has floor-to-ceiling windows framing panoramic views of Hollywood.
The hotel has an AI-powered Aescape massage table that uses body-mapping technology for a personalized full-body massage.

considerations.text: The hotel sits right on Hollywood Boulevard and draws influencers, entertainment industry insiders and party-goers.
Rooms do not have a coffee or tea maker.
Santa Monica is about a 45-minute drive away without rush hour traffic.
